name: How long does it take to complete a room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room addition project depends on its scope and complexity, as well as the permitting process. Smaller additions might take a few months, while larger or more complex projects could extend to six months or more. We provide a projected timeline during the planning phase, and we strive to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity, typically ranging from a few months to over six months.
